in_hebrew.name: Balliett
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Balliett הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Ballias', meaning 'tender, little, or protector'. Balliett can be translated as 'little warrior'. This name was given to babies born into noble families or those who were expected to protect and serve.
